items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: why don't put Joe Blow instead of Miss Blow, and they want half of the song.

ctx.x: There must have been other situations where you were just an arranger, and you went in and made changes on a song.

Yeah. But I mean, not enough to say that you should get part of the song. Yeah. You know, because that's your job, man, to do the best that you can with the song, and if there's any addition, if it's going to be beneficial to the song, then you should, you know, you should do it. But some people, man, they hear you writing a song, and they come up with, man, why don't put Joe Blow instead of Miss Blow, and they want half of the song.

Right. Yeah. It seems to me that you came from this big band background, and when I hear stuff, things like Groove Me, and even Barefoot, and it's just, it's this very small, little, tight little, you've planned this.
